hook: Artificial intelligence just cracked open 461 years of hidden history.

sections.voiceover: Artificial intelligence just cracked open 461 years of hidden history.
sections.visual_cue: Close-up shot of handwritten historical port records glowing under digital scanning light.
sections.sfx_cue: Digital scan sound and paper rustling
b_roll: Digital scanning equipment over old paper
sections.animation_cue: Fade in from black with subtle text glow

sections.voiceover: Researchers at the University of Southampton trained artificial intelligence to process exactly 100,000 pages of handwritten documents. These fragile port books held secrets of Britain for centuries. Where did those records come from?
sections.visual_cue: Medium shot of University of Southampton researchers examining computer screens showing digital manuscript scans.
sections.sfx_cue: Subtle typing and ambient lab hum
b_roll: Computer monitor displaying digitized old manuscript pages
sections.animation_cue: Slow zoom in on the computer screen
sections.transition_out: Quick cross dissolve to archive documents

sections.voiceover: Except reading the old text was only the beginning of the discovery.
sections.visual_cue: Close-up on ancient handwritten ink fading across aged paper texture.
b_roll: Detailed macro shot of historical handwriting
sections.animation_cue: Fast pan across lines of historical text

sections.voiceover: The University of Southampton team created a massive database of sea trade spanning 200 years. That vast network officially starts from the year 1565.
sections.visual_cue: Wide shot of a digital trade map rendering thousands of historical shipping routes across Britain.
sections.sfx_cue: Digital chime and data loading sound
b_roll: Map of Britain with historical sea trade routes highlighted
sections.animation_cue: Rapid data points appearing on a digital map

sections.voiceover: Four hundred sixty-one years of maritime past decoded through artificial intelligence.
sections.visual_cue: Cinematic wide shot of the University of Southampton campus exterior at dusk.
b_roll: University of Southampton exterior building shot
